website.data: AR Daniel Construction – Our Experience Runs Deep About Us Services Our Work Job Openings Contact 972-291-3304 Download Fact Sheet 972-291-3304 Fact Sheet Home About Us Services Our Work Job Openings 972-291-3304 Download Fact Sheet Contact Our Experience RUNS DEEP Over 35 Years of Trenchless Construction Experience Our decades of experience and attention to detail has made AR Daniel Construction a recognized leader in trenchless construction in Texas. AR Daniel Construction Services specializes in trenchless construction. Our services include horizontal earth boring, tunneling, shaft excavation, and pipe jacking. We have extremely high quality standards and we pride ourselves in delivering solutions on time, on budget, and with as minimal a footprint as possible. In short, we stand out by not being seen. Contact us today to put our experience to work on your next project. Learn more about the variety of services we provide to our clients across Texas. SERVICES Interested in our capabilities? Take a look at some of our completed projects. OUR WORK View our history, representative projects, and references on our Fact Sheet DOWNLOAD FACT SHEET OUR VALUES Safety Never sacrifice safety for production Our People Without a committed and well trained workforce we cease to exist Integrity The shortest path to success Accountability to each other and to our clients Pursuit of Excellence Excellence is our standard and we should never stop raising the bar Growing Value for Shareholders creating a return on investment Stewardship to Industry & Community giving back to the industry and communities from which we have grown OUR VISION The safety of our employees, their character and expertise, teamed with a pursuit of excellence, will drive superior financial returns and lead us to be recognized as the preferred partner to build trenchless construction solutions. OUR LEADERSHIP Click to view team member bios ART DANIEL, President and CEO Art Daniel, is President and COO of AR Daniel Construction Services, Inc.. Mr. Daniel has been involved in the utility construction industry for over forty years. Prior to founding AR Daniel Construction Services in 2005, Mr. Daniel served as Executive Vice President of Boring and Tunnelling Co. of America, Inc.. Mr. Daniel received his Bachelors degree from Houston Baptist University. Mr. Daniel also studied civil engineering at The University of Texas at Arlington and graduate studies in landscape architecture at The Unviersity of Texas at Arlington. Mr. Daniel’s industry involvement includes AGC of Texas Water and Wastewater Committee, AGC of Texas-ACEC Joint Committee, AGC of Texas-TxDOT Joint Committee, AGC of Texas Trenchless Technology Committee (past Chair), Municipal & Utilities Division Chairman, Dallas Area Chair of the AGC of Texas, Past President of AGC of Texas. Mr. Daniel currently serves on several AGC of America committees and is past Chair for the AGC of America Municipal and Utility Division is a Life Governor of AGC of America, he currently is a member of the Board of Governors of AGC of America and served as the 2017 President of AGC of America. Mr. Daniel served as member of the Board of Directors of Texas811 from 1998 to 2014, one of the one-call centers in Texas. He is also a member of North American Society for Trenchless Technology. Mr. Daniel has been a presenter on the topic of Risk Allocation, Damage Prevention, Trenchless Technology, and Public Private Partnerships to various organizations. Mr. Daniel served as a member of the TERP Advisory Board for the TCEQ from 2004 - 2020. Mr. Daniel and his wife Robbie live in Cedar Hill, Texas and have two grown children. BO DAVIS, Vice President of Operations Robert "Bo" Davis is a Project Manager at AR Daniel Construction Services, Inc. Bo is our primary contact for business development. Bo started as a laborer in the field and worked his way through every aspect of the business. Prior to joining ARDCS, Bo worked in restaurant management for 12 years. Bo is certified as an excavator, forklift, and crane operator, along with many hours of training in other areas of utility construction. He is a member of the AGC of Texas, serving as the Boring and Tunneling Committee Chairman for 2009-2010 DAVID HOYLE, General Superintendent David Hoyle is the General Superintendent for AR Daniel Construction Services, Inc., bringing over 40 years of experience in the utility construction industry. David has over forty years of trenchless construction experience. David oversees all AR Daniel Construction field operations, ensuring that work product and safety standards are held to ARDCS's rigorous standards. He has been trained in many areas of the utility construction industry. JOHN REEVES, Controller John Reeves joined AR Daniel in May 2010 as Controller bringing over 30 years of accounting and management experience in various fields. He graduated from Texas Tech University with a Bachelor of Business Administration in Accounting in December 1978. He has been a member of several professional associations and is a member of the Construction Financial Management Association. BRYAN A DANIEL, Vice President of Administration Bryan serves primarily as project manager for AR Daniel Construction Services, Inc. Bryan has a bachelors degree in Organization Leadership from Texas A&M University - Commerce. Bryan has over 10 years of project management experience. Bryan has been the project manager for tunneling projects for the NTMWD's Trinity River Main Stem Pipeline, TRWD's Integrated Pipeline Project, numerous City of Houston Projects including 4 for 108” waterline and other TxDOT projects. Bryan also manages AR Daniel Construction's IT infrastructure and fleet of equipment. 506 Tidwell St. Cedar Hill, TX 75104 Office: 972-291-3304 Fax: 972-291-4475 Follow Us on Facebook Send Us a Message © Copyright 2023 Site Design by TIK:TALK Send a Message to AR Daniel Construction Thank you for your message, a member of our team will respond soon.
